mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batches (id, status, merkle_root, leaf_count, opened_at, sealed_at) VALUES (#{id}, 'sealed', #{merkleRoot}, #{leafCount}, #{ts}, #{ts})
mapper.update: UPDATE attestations SET batch_id = #{batchId}, leaf_index = #{leafIndex}, status = 'batched' WHERE id = #{id} AND batch_id IS NULL AND kind <> 'inscription'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO anchor_attempts (batch_id, attempt, txid, raw_tx_hex, payload_hex, state, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{attempt}, #{txid}, #{rawTxHex}, #{payloadHex}, 'recorded', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE anchor_attempts SET state = #{state}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND attempt = #{attempt} AND state = 'recorded'

UPDATE worker_leases SET owner = #{owner}, expires_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) + INTERVAL #{ttlSeconds} SECOND, renewed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE name = #{name} AND (owner = #{owner} OR expires_at < UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO worker_leases (name, owner, expires_at, renewed_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{owner}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) + INTERVAL #{ttlSeconds} SECOND, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE worker_leases SET expires_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) + INTERVAL #{ttlSeconds} SECOND, renewed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE name = #{name} AND owner = #{owner} AND expires_at >= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM worker_leases WHERE name = #{name} AND owner = #{owner}
mapper.select: SELECT owner, (expires_at < UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AS expired FROM worker_leases WHERE name = #{name}
